Title: Si vous n'aimez pas ça, n'en dégoûtez pas les autres
Actors: Josiane Balasko, Odile Barbier, Romain Bouteille
Plot: A bunch of actors (mixed theater gangs from Le Café de la Gare and Le Splendid) are reunited in a movie theater to watch an anonymous porn flick. Their reactions to the images. All dialogs have been improvised.
